blockers: Raw data deposited in EGA (EGAS00001003667) under controlled access, requiring data access committee approval

Library layout (single vs paired-end) not stated

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Directly reports the dataset sample count (35 WE + 19 TE = 54 samples).
comparison_targets.claim_text: The resulting data set includes 35 WE samples, 19 TE biopsies, 21 PGT-A results, and 10 morphokinetic grades representing 39 unique embryos

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Average raw sequencing depth per library is a per-sample read count, matching total_sequences; mean_reads_per_cell is a single-cell metric that does not apply to bulk RNA-seq libraries.
comparison_targets.claim_text: Each RNA-seq library was sequenced to an average depth of approximately 44.6 million reads

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Distinct expressed transcripts detected across WE samples matches total_genes_detected.
comparison_targets.claim_text: For WE, we identified 13,175 expressed transcripts, whereas TE samples expressed 6086 transcripts

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Distinct expressed transcripts detected across TE samples matches total_genes_detected.
Differentially expressed gene count is not a controlled metric; no de_gene_count key exists in the vocabulary.
comparison_targets.claim_text: We identified 194 significantly differentially expressed genes of which 146 are sex-linked

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Differentially regulated gene count between aneuploid/euploid is not in the controlled vocabulary.
comparison_targets.claim_text: We found five genes down-regulated and 48 genes up-regulated in the aneuploid samples compared with the euploid samples (53 total differentially regulated genes)

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Differentially regulated gene count for morphology comparison is not a controlled metric.
comparison_targets.claim_text: we found five genes up-regulated and five genes down-regulated in the morphologically aberrant samples
comparison_targets.sample_subset: whole embryo AA vs CC morphology

comparison_targets.binding_reason: Differentially regulated gene count for morphokinetics comparison is not a controlled metric.
comparison_targets.claim_text: we compared transcriptional profiles of embryos with high- and poor-quality morphokinetics and found three genes down-regulated and six up-regulated in samples meeting strong morphokinetic standards
comparison_targets.sample_subset: whole embryo high vs low morphokinetic quality

contrasts.name: good vs poor morphology (Gardner AA vs CC) WE

reproduction_plan.mapping_notes: Mapped assay 'bulk RNA-seq (low-input Smart-seq2)' (tools: RSEM v1.2.29, FastQC, fastx_toolkit, DESeq2, R/Bioconductor) to nf-core/rnaseq 3.14.0. The original toolchain differs from nf-core, so exact metric reproduction is not guaranteed.
